SheetJS Community Edition 0.20.3, "mini" build (XLSX/CSV read and write), Apache-2.0 (see LICENSE).
Obtained from the npm package @e965/xlsx@0.20.3 (a republish of the official SheetJS CE release;
the official tarball at cdn.sheetjs.com was not reachable from the build environment).
npm shasum 4577f2c7691137d3e315018218ba2b76e4721ba9. File header reads "xlsx.js (C) 2013-present SheetJS", version 0.20.3.
Not used: npm "xlsx" 0.18.5 (prototype pollution CVE-2023-30533, ReDoS CVE-2024-22363).
Loaded lazily only when a spreadsheet is opened or exported. Read options disable formulas, VBA and HTML.
